findings.summary: The YAML check treats colons inside valid trailing comments as syntax errors.
findings.failure_scenario: A command with frontmatter `description: Review changes # owner: team` now fails `check --kind command --strict` with `frontmatter_yaml`, although the YAML is valid and the pre-change check accepted it.
findings.fix: Exclude YAML comment text before checking plain scalars for forbidden colon sequences, while preserving hashes inside quoted and block values. Add a regression test containing a colon in a trailing comment.

findings.summary: Valid multiline YAML flow collections are rejected because only their opening line is checked.
findings.failure_scenario: A command with a valid description and `allowed-tools: [Read,` followed by an indented `Grep]` now fails strict checking because `bad_flow_collection` cannot see the closing bracket on the continuation line.
findings.fix: Accumulate continuation lines before validating a flow collection, or exclude multiline collections from this explicitly line-based heuristic. Add a strict-check regression test for multiline allowed-tools.

findings.summary: Queue updates can destroy the existing resume state when an in-place write fails.
findings.failure_scenario: With an existing `batches.json`, a `batches set` or `batches waive` operation encounters ENOSPC after `Path.write_text` truncates the file; the command exits 2 but leaves empty or partial JSON, so subsequent operations cannot load the previous queue and waivers.
findings.fix: Write the serialized queue to a temporary file under the output directory and atomically replace `batches.json` only after writing and closing succeed. Preserve the containment checks and remove the temporary file on failure.
